audit_events_labels_length.name: audit_events_labels_length
audit_events_labels_length.value: char_length(entity_type) between 1 and 64 and char_length(action) between 1 and 64 and char_length(request_id) between 1 and 128

outbox_events_labels_length.name: outbox_events_labels_length
outbox_events_labels_length.value: char_length(type) between 1 and 128 and char_length(aggregate_type) between 1 and 64

task_field_definition_versions_snapshot_.name: task_field_definition_versions_snapshot_identity
task_field_definition_versions_snapshot_.value: (jsonb_typeof(snapshot) = 'object' and snapshot ->> 'id' = field_id::text and snapshot ->> 'workspaceId' = workspace_id::text and snapshot ->> 'projectId' = project_id::text and snapshot ->> 'definitionVersionId' = id::text and snapshot -> 'revision' = to_jsonb(revision)) is true

task_field_value_history_after_shape.name: task_field_value_history_after_shape
task_field_value_history_after_shape.value: (case when jsonb_typeof("after") = 'object' then "after" ? 'type' and "after" ? 'value' and "after" - 'type' - 'value' = '{}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("after" -> 'type') = 'string' and "after" ->> 'type' in ('text', 'number', 'duration', 'date', 'single_select', 'multi_select', 'person', 'boolean', 'url') else false end) is true

task_field_value_history_before_shape.name: task_field_value_history_before_shape
task_field_value_history_before_shape.value: "before" is null or (case when jsonb_typeof("before") = 'object' then "before" ? 'type' and "before" ? 'value' and "before" - 'type' - 'value' = '{}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof("before" -> 'type') = 'string' and "before" ->> 'type' = "after" ->> 'type' else false end) is true

task_field_values_value_shape.name: task_field_values_value_shape
task_field_values_value_shape.value: (case when jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object' then value ? 'type' and value ? 'value' and value - 'type' - 'value' = '{}'::jsonb and jsonb_typeof(value -> 'type') = 'string' else false end) is true

task_field_values_value_primitive.name: task_field_values_value_primitive
task_field_values_value_primitive.value:
(jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'null' or case
        when field_type = 'text' then jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'string' and char_length(value ->> 'value') <= 10000
        when field_type = 'number' then case when jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'number' then (value -> 'value')::numeric between -1000000000000 and 1000000000000 else false end
        when field_type = 'duration' then case when jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'number' then (value -> 'value')::numeric between 0 and 2147483647 and (value -> 'value')::numeric = trunc((value -> 'value')::numeric) else false end
        when field_type = 'date' then jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'string' and value ->> 'value' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
        when field_type = 'single_select' then jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'string' and value ->> 'value' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
        when field_type in ('multi_select', 'person') then case when jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'array' then jsonb_array_length(value -> 'value') <= 100 and not jsonb_path_exists(value -> 'value', '$[*] ? (@.type() != "string" || !(@ like_regex "^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))') else false end
        when field_type = 'boolean' then jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'boolean'
        when field_type = 'url' then jsonb_typeof(value -> 'value') = 'string' and char_length(value ->> 'value') <= 2048 and value ->> 'value' ~* '^https?://'
        else false
      end) is true

tasks_parent_not_self.name: tasks_parent_not_self
tasks_parent_not_self.value: parent_task_id is null or parent_task_id <> id

work_packages_source_not_self.name: work_packages_source_not_self
work_packages_source_not_self.value: source_package_id is null or source_package_id <> id
